limits: The coarse solved state is replayed at finer 4/4/8 quadratures. A residual near 0.3795 is not an accepted fine-grid atmosphere root.
Bitwise equality covers the three executed directions at one state/environment, not every parameter or derivative direction.
The new direct JVP times remain about 16--17 seconds; no speedup is claimed. Production reverse execution and its memory/time are separate unfinished evidence.
The earlier cached-JVP failure is a predeclared numerical-comparison failure, not evidence of a physical-model defect or a general failure of jax.linearize.
The earlier timing comparison contains only one first application per kernel; remaining directions and warm repetitions were not executed.
No scientific root, implicit solution derivative, physical adequacy, observation equivalence or NUTS readiness follows. All six full-use Assessments stay unchanged.
